name: Three Old Ladies
excerpt: Three old ladies at a fruit stand knit enormous socks and cut yarn, ominously observed by Grover.
notes:
The three old ladies are seen at a fruit stand knitting large socks. The middle lady cuts the yarn with large scissors, which deeply unsettles Grover. They seem to have a significant, possibly supernatural role, as indicated by Grover's reaction.

The Three Old Ladies are revealed to be the Fates, who appear when someone is about to die, indicating their ominous role in Percy's life.
